## Behavior

Describe the concrete trigger, previous behavior and resulting behavior. Keep the scope tied to 源证据关联、控制判断、复核版本绑定与底稿重放.

## Evidence

Include a minimal synthetic example or an independently calculated expectation when behavior changes. Explain any intentional contract, compatibility or saved-evidence change; do not refresh expected outputs merely to make a verifier pass.

## Validation

List the commands run and their results using [the contribution guide](https://github.com/dev-belly/ControlTrace/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). For documentation or configuration changes, record link/YAML checks instead of unrelated model runs. State checks that could not run and why.

## Data and boundaries

Confirm that added examples can be published and retain their source attribution. 注明控制 ID、发现 ID、证据变化前后、复核状态及 ZIP 格式版本；并发问题请按顺序列出两个会话的操作。
